page_title: BOL 3-3 INT | Bologna v Inter 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Nadir Zortea (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Inter.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
89' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
88' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Federico Bernardeschi and he is replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
86' 3 - 3 Goal! Luka Topalovic tees up Andy Diouf (Inter) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top right corner. 3:3.
85' Luka Topalovic (Inter) dribbles into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
81' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Luka Topalovic comes onto the pitch to replace him.
81' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) replaces Eivind Fauske Helland.
80' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' The referee blows his whistle as Jens Odgaard (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
78' A clumsy foul by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Bologna will take a free kick near the side line.
77' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
76' Nikola Moro (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Kevin Bonacina had a clear view and blows his whistle.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
74' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!
74' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Cocchi (Inter) replacing Petar Sucic.
73' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Andy Diouf (Inter) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post.
66' Substitution. Tommaso Pobega will be replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
66' Here is a change. Remo Freuler is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Nikola Moro (Bologna).
66' Here's the change. Lorenzo De Silvestri leaves the pitch and Nadir Zortea (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
66' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
64' 3 - 2 Goal 3:2! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
64' Andy Diouf (Inter) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
61' A long pass, executed by Petar Sucic (Inter), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
60' The ball is cleared after Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' Andy Diouf (Inter) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
57' Carlos Augusto (Inter) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
56' What a huge chance for Carlos Augusto (Inter). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
56' Inter earn a corner.
54' That's the end of the game for Federico Dimarco, who is replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
54' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Nicolo Barella will be replaced by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
54' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lautaro Martinez as he is replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
53' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
53' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
51' Santiago Castro (Bologna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
48' 3 - 1 This is definitely not what Piotr Zielinski (Inter) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 3:1.
47' Petar Sucic (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Kevin Bonacina no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Corner kick. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is ready to send the ball into the box.

45+1' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
42' 2 - 1 Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Josep Martinez. 2:1.
41' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Kevin Bonacina and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
40' Santiago Castro (Bologna) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
39' Remo Freuler (Bologna) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Santiago Castro, but Josep Martinez displays great awareness to stop him.
37' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
36' Petar Sucic (Inter) is penalised for holding. Kevin Bonacina signals a set piece. Bologna earn a free kick.
34' A rebound falls to Remo Freuler (Bologna) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
33' Kevin Bonacina interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna).
31' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
30' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
29' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
25' 1 - 1 Goal! Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
22' 0 - 1 What a goal! Federico Dimarco (Inter) bangs the ball home from a perfectly executed free kick.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
21' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Inter have a free kick from a promising distance.
21' Wonderful pass from Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) for Santiago Castro, but they can't profit from it as Josep Martinez comes off his line to collect.
19' Carlos Augusto (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
17' Petar Sucic (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Skorupski punches the ball away.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
13' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
13' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
12' Yann Bisseck (Inter) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bologna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
8' Federico Dimarco (Inter) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
8' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Kevin Bonacina signals a foul.
6' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) tries to find Lewis Ferguson, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
2' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
